thread:
Maria: Heads up — saw a flurry of lease evictions on microqueue-7 in canary-A. p50 fine but p95 spiked and some token-affinity misses. Posting rollback/handshake ideas.

Aj: Can you paste the logs? which lane?

Maria: lane=interactive, tenant=canary-A. snippet:
``
I0123 12:03:45 lease.go:211 evict leaseID=lc-9 reason=peer-loss headroom=0.02 slot=3
``

Sam: Hmm that headroom looks wrong. We tightened soft-lease threshold in PR #428 last week. Could be too aggressive compaction + late-join storm.

Devon: If eviction ordering is causing thrash, fallback should be explicit: rollback to per-tenant microqueue with a handshake. Sketch:
- mark lease retiring
- stop accepting new late-joins
- drain inflight within a short window
- rehydrate queue on target lane and resume

Aj: Agree, but requeueing loses kv-cache warmups. Need warmup hints and ordering preservation.

Maria: Proposed rollback playbook (draft). TL;DR keep tail latency bounded and avoid repeated oscillation.

Maria: PLAYBOOK:
- detection: >X leases evicted in 60s OR p95 latency > configured threshold
- mark leases as `retiring` and publish event `lease.retire.{id}`
- handlers: batcher rejects new enqueues for retiring lease and routes to fallback pool (same model variant)
- drain window: 250ms soft, 2s hard; after soft window, start opportunistic reassign; after hard window force-move
- rehydrate: recreate tenant microqueue on target lane with kv warmup hint `warmup_hint=true`
- ordering: preserve `serial_id` per request and replay deterministically
- metrics: emit `rollback.initiated`, `rollback.completed`, `rollback.failed`

Sam: Include entitlement check: dedicated tenants shouldn't be failovered to shared pool without quota/approval.

Devon: Also add circuit-breaker/backoff: if rollback fails repeatedly, stop automatic rollbacks for that tenant and open an incident.

Aj: For ordering: tag enqueued requests with `serial_id` and snapshot in-flight tail. Replay should preserve order when receipts are available; otherwise best-effort.

Maria: Good — add `serial_id` propagation and replay logic in rehydrate step.

infra-bot: deploy_log: rollout v0.67.3 started by @Maria. Canaries: canary-A

Nate: Quick perf note — rehydration + warmup hints increases memory pressure. Consider `warmup_prefix_tokens=128` rather than full kv reload.

Sam: +1 to partial warmup. If we warm just prefixes we keep latency wins without huge mem spike.

Devon: I'll draft an RFC follow-up describing the retire API, lifecycle states (`active->retiring->migrating->rehydrated`), and rollback choreography.

Maria: Can we do a 15m sync tomorrow 10:00 to align on guardrails and telemetry? :calendar:

Aj: +1

Sam: +1

Devon: +1

Maria: Action items:
- Devon: RFC follow-up (retire API + rollback choreography) — due EOD Wed
- Sam: prototype partial warmup + perf test (warmup_prefix_tokens) — due Thu
- Aj: add metrics & circuit-breaker hooks (`rollback.*`) — due Fri
- Maria: enable rollback toggle in canary run — target Mon

Aj: I'll open a tracking thread and link this doc.

Maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
